# Free Class Schedule Maker

Free Class Schedule Maker (https://freeclassschedule.com) is a free online class schedule and weekly timetable maker for college, university and school students. It runs 100% in the browser — no sign-up, no account, no data leaves the device. Built by Shah Fahid, Full Stack AI Engineer.

## What it does

- Build a weekly class schedule on a 5-day or 7-day grid (8 AM–8 PM), add courses once for multiple days (MWF, TTh)
- Automatic conflict detection: overlapping classes render side-by-side with alert borders
- Auto-Gap Optimizer: measures idle "dead time" between classes and helps consolidate the day
- Drag & drop rescheduling, colour-coded courses, credits and idle-gap counters
- Export to Google Calendar / Apple Calendar / Outlook (.ICS), printable PDF, and phone lock-screen PNG wallpaper
- Tasks & deadlines tracker beside the timetable
